name: 净水壶替换滤芯清泉蓝调款
description: 蓝白清泉色系套图，覆盖白底主图、卖点微距、换芯场景与空表对照

styleLock.direction: clean drinking-water accessory commerce in cool aqua blue
styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF for packshots, flat saturated blue #2E6FE8 and deep navy #103A66 graphic fields for infographic screens, pale sky #A9D4EE and marble #E9E7E3 for lifestyle scenes; never a random unrelated backdrop
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright high-key studio light with a front-left key and soft fill, one controlled specular along the moulded shell, soft contact shadows that ground every unit, cool cast held identical across the set
styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless white sweep #FFFFFF, polished marble counter #E9E7E3, flat colour graphic panels #2E6FE8 / #14688C / #103A66
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif reserved for post-production only; every headline and label area ships as a clean empty panel with no glyphs
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons and hollow circular marker outlines in #7FC7E8, never filled data marks
styleLock.presentationRules: identical slight 3/4 or straight-on angle and stable scale for the product on every screen; crops always sit on the same body section so the unit reads as one object across the set
noDrift: no filled-in claims, badges or table values
no redesign of the product silhouette
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean drinking-water accessory ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white #FFFFFF, saturated blue #2E6FE8, deep navy #103A66 and light aqua accent #7FC7E8; cool high-key studio lighting with a front-left key, soft contact shadows and one controlled specular on moulded shells; modern geometric sans-serif held for post-production only while every copy area renders as a clean empty panel; consistent thin single-weight line icon style with hollow marker outlines; flat colour graphic fields or seamless white sweeps only, never random backdrops; stable slight 3/4 or straight-on product angle and scale on every screen; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no filled-in claims or badges or table values, no redesign of the product silhouette.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼看清是同型多支的替换耗材，拿下首屏点击
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, several identical units in one evenly spaced horizontal row, every unit fully visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with a soft fill card on the shadow side, faint contact shadow under each base
shots.whitespace: even white margins on all four sides, no extra whitespace inside the row
shots.promptTemplate: Product packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Several identical units stood in one evenly spaced horizontal row on a seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, photographed straight-on at eye level so every unit is fully visible and nothing is clipped by the frame. Bright even high-key studio lighting from the front with a soft fill card on the shadow side, faint soft contact shadows under each base so nothing floats. The row occupies 60-70% of the frame with even margins on all four sides and no extra whitespace inside the row. Wide horizontal 4:3 crop, 4K commercial e-commerce quality, crisp silhouette edges. Negative: no letterforms, no words, no numbers, no corner flags, no count badges, no logos, no props, no hands, no coloured cast on the white field, no gradient background, no overlapping or duplicated units, no floating bases.

shots.intent: 一秒把核心利益主张钉在蓝色主视觉上，留出干净的标题空版
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, unit pushed into the right third, cropped from the shoulder down
shots.lighting: soft key from the upper left with gentle falloff, one controlled specular running down the shoulder
shots.props: one empty rounded label chip below the unit
shots.whitespace: generous clean negative space across the left 45% reserved for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The unit sits in the right third of the frame at a slight 3/4 angle, cropped from the shoulder down so the collar silhouette dominates, on a flat saturated blue field #2E6FE8. Soft key light from the upper left with gentle falloff and one controlled specular running down the shoulder, no harsh shadow. A clean empty rounded label chip in #FFFFFF floats below the unit and carries nothing. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame with generous negative space held across the left 45% for copy. 2K commercial quality. Negative: no headline text, no letterforms, no glyphs, no bullet list, no droplet icons used as data, no certification marks, no logos, no watermark, no gradient on the blue field, no extra props.

shots.intent: 用同机位双栏放大耗材用久后的浑浊状态，制造换芯紧迫感
shots.camera: matched straight-on eye-level framing, identical crop on both panels
shots.lighting: left panel flat heavy top light and dull; right panel soft bright key from the upper left
shots.background: pale steel field #E4E9EC on both panels
shots.props: a clear water jug with a faint film line on the inner wall on the left panel only
shots.whitespace: narrow gutter of whitespace between the two panels
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels with identical straight-on eye-level framing and identical crop. Left panel: one spent, dulled used unit of {product} standing inside a clear water jug with a faint film line on the inner wall, lit by flat heavy top light so it reads neglected, with no reading and no label anywhere. Right panel: {product} clean and crisp under a soft key from the upper left. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Background pale steel field #E4E9EC on both panels so only the state changes. The product occupies 40-50% of each panel with a narrow gutter of whitespace between them. 2K quality. Negative: no readable text, no dates or percentages, no before-and-after arrows, no versus labels, no real competitor item, no grime smeared on the clean unit, no faces, no painted-on dirt, no mismatched lighting between the two panels.

shots.intent: 用微距证明做工与进水结构，把质感变成可信度
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro from a high 45-degree angle looking down into the funnel mouth, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right sweeping across the slots, one controlled specular, no blown highlights
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the flared funnel mouth and its slotted collar. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down into the opening, shallow depth of field with the nearest slot edges crisp and the body falling softly out of focus. A skimming side light from the right sweeps across the moulded ribs to reveal texture, with one controlled specular and no blown highlights. Background a deep navy studio surface #103A66. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame with minimal surrounding whitespace because the texture is the subject. 4K macro quality. Negative: no blurry subject, no whole product visible, no letterforms, no logos, no water droplets, no hands, no teal colour cast, no repeated slot pattern, no banding noise.

shots.intent: 把换芯放回真实厨房动线，让买家代入自家水壶
shots.camera: slight 3/4 eye-level with a candid handheld feel, unit framed from the shoulder down
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left around 5500K, gentle contact shadow under the base
shots.background: polished marble counter #E9E7E3 with a tiled wall in #F2F4F5 behind
shots.props: one clear water jug behind the unit, softly out of focus, plus a folded linen cloth at the far edge, never covering the product
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 35% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} resting on a polished marble kitchen counter #E9E7E3 in front of a softly out-of-focus clear water jug, a tiled wall in #F2F4F5 behind. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed at a slight 3/4 eye-level angle with a candid handheld feel, the unit framed from its shoulder down rather than as a full packshot. Soft morning window light from the left around 5500K, gentle contact shadow under the base, no flat studio falloff. Props limited to the jug and one folded linen cloth at the far edge, never covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with generous negative space on the right 35% for copy. Negative: no hands, no face, no splashing water, no letterforms, no logos, no clutter, no contradictory shadow directions, no plastic-looking water.

shots.intent: 以剖视线稿解释结构原理，参数位全部留空不自证
shots.camera: flat lay, photographed from directly above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even flat graphic lighting, no modelling shadow, hairline stroke weight held constant
shots.props: thin line leader rules running to a column of empty label blocks on the left
shots.whitespace: wide margins of whitespace around the empty label column
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce infographic mechanism screen: a white line-art cross-section drawing of one upright {product} shown in elevation on a deep teal panel #14688C. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat lay composition photographed from directly above at a 90-degree overhead angle, the drawing centred on the right half with thin leader rules running out to a column of blank label blocks on the left, every block left empty with no glyphs. Even flat graphic lighting with no modelling shadow and one constant hairline stroke weight. The diagram occupies 35-40% of the frame with wide margins of whitespace around the label column. Negative: no readable text, no letter shapes, no particle or dot counts presented as data, no arrows implying proven results, no serial numbers, no QR codes, no photographic product, no gradient background.

shots.intent: 保留多品牌横向对照的分镜骨架，主张与品牌全部留白
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view of the flat graphic plane so every row reads level
shots.lighting: even diffused flat light, no cast shadow on the table
shots.background: white table panel #FFFFFF inside a saturated blue frame #2E6FE8
shots.props: empty header slots, blank row-label chips and hollow circular marker outlines only
shots.whitespace: clear whitespace gutters between rows and around the frame
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce comparison matrix screen on a white panel #FFFFFF framed by a saturated blue field #2E6FE8. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. A deep navy header bar #103A66 carries empty column slots with no names, and beneath it a stacked row of blank row-label chips; every intersection holds only a hollow circular marker outline waiting for a value. {product} appears as a small cut-out at the head of the first column at a slight 3/4 angle. Straight-on eye-level view of the flat graphic plane so all rows read perfectly level, with even diffused lighting and no cast shadow. The table and cut-out together occupy 50-60% of the frame with clear whitespace gutters between rows. Negative: no brand names, no model codes, no substance lists, no filled check or cross glyphs, no numbers, no letterforms, no trademark symbols, no dense body copy, no implied test results.

shots.intent: 并排三档选型帮助买家确认自己该拿哪一栏，首栏高亮
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, identical for all three units and identical scale across the row
shots.lighting: soft front key with light falloff to the edges, matching contact shadows under all three bases
shots.background: saturated blue field #2E6FE8 with a lighter outlined card in the first column
shots.props: three blank label chips and one rounded highlight frame in #7FC7E8
shots.whitespace: even whitespace band above the label row
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant chooser screen: three units of {product} standing side by side on a saturated blue field #2E6FE8. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. All three shown at the identical slight 3/4 angle and identical scale so nothing looks like a second camera pass, each standing above its own blank label chip; the leftmost column is picked out with a thin rounded highlight frame in #7FC7E8 and a lighter panel behind it. Soft front key light with gentle falloff to the edges and matching contact shadows under all three bases. The row of units occupies 50-60% of the frame with an even whitespace band above the label row. Negative: no tier names, no numbers, no month or capacity or count figures, no certification wording, no letterforms, no differing lighting between columns, no colour drift across the units, no overlapping silhouettes.

shots.intent: 用举杯看水的动作完成场景代入，人脸全部裁掉规避肖像
shots.camera: photographed from a very low angle looking upward at the raised glass, person cropped below the chin
shots.lighting: hard natural backlight with a small lens-flare sweep, warm rim along the fingers, no studio fill
shots.background: bright open sky #A9D4EE with a soft horizon haze
shots.props: one clear drinking glass filled with water, one generic hand and forearm entering from the lower left
shots.whitespace: open sky as negative space across the top 40% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: a raised clear glass of water held up against a bright open sky #A9D4EE, photographed from a very low angle looking upward so the daylight passes straight through the water. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Only one generic hand and forearm enter the frame from the lower left and the person is cropped below the chin so no face is visible at all. {product} stands softly out of focus on a pale ledge at the right edge so the product reads as the reason for the clarity. Hard natural backlight with a small lens-flare sweep and a warm rim along the fingers, no studio fill. The glass and product together occupy 40-50% of the frame with open sky as negative space across the top 40% for copy. Negative: no identifiable face, no child features, no deformed or extra fingers, no logo on the glass, no letterforms, no splash gimmicks, no heavy skin retouching, no duplicated hand.

shots.intent: 沿用圆形印章加斜跨缎带的信任版式，但资质一律留空待贴

shots.lighting: controlled soft key from the upper left plus a subtle rim separating the unit from the dark field
shots.background: deep navy panel #103A66 with a faint concentric ring texture
shots.props: one blank circular seal ring with an empty crossing ribbon banner at the upper left, plus a short stack of empty label bars

At the upper left sits one blank circular seal ring with an empty ribbon banner crossing it, both left completely bare as proof placeholders, and beneath them a short stack of empty label bars in #FFFFFF. The seal and the product together occupy 50-60% of the frame with clean whitespace around the empty label bars. Negative: no certification names, no standards wording, no accredited marks, no award laurels, no star ratings, no sales or ranking wording, no letterforms, no numbers, no foil textures implying grade, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以空版零售盒加单支做收口，把促销位留给后期真实优惠
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, carton turned a few degrees into a slight 3/4 so its depth reads, unit beside it
shots.lighting: bright even high-key lighting with a soft front key and fill, soft contact shadows under both objects
shots.props: one upright blank retail carton with an empty corner flag shape and an empty base strip
shots.whitespace: even margins on all sides, no extra whitespace between carton and unit
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce closing packshot of {product} standing beside its upright blank retail carton on a seamless pure white background #FFFFFF, both photographed straight-on at eye level with the carton turned a few degrees into a slight 3/4 so its depth reads. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The carton face is rendered as a brand-safe blank panel: one large empty colour block, an empty corner flag shape and a reserved empty strip along the base for the real offer, all carrying no glyphs. Bright even high-key lighting with a soft front key and fill and soft contact shadows under both objects. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame with even margins and no extra whitespace between the two. 4K quality. Negative: no letterforms, no logos, no barcodes, no QR codes, no discount numbers, no countdown timers, no price tags, no promotional burst graphics, no cut-off carton edges, no reflection streaks across the carton face.

provenance.notes: 14 张源图逐图事实：图001 深蓝零售盒与单支产品组合的白底图，左上角圆形印章、右上角件数角标；图002 亮蓝底大标题空栏加产品上部斜切特写加左侧成组要点列表；图003 亮蓝底三栏选型对照，首栏描边高亮，底部三支产品剪影并排；图004 晴空下童手举杯对光的场景，人物露出半张脸；图005 亮蓝底金色圆形认证印章加产品右侧斜切特写；图006 大理石台面加虚化透明水壶与产品的场景图；图007 蓝色放射底圆形徽章加斜跨缎带条与两行说明；图008 深蓝表头的多列对照表，左侧行标签配成排水滴标记格；图009 户外虚化背景人物举杯饮水场景；图010 蓝调多格产品矩阵拼贴，中心标题卡加圆形排名徽章；图011 纯白底多支同型产品横向等距排列；图012 零售盒四分之三透视加盒面水面波纹印刷；图013 盒背剖视线稿加引线标注栏与方形扫码图；图014 零售盒正面平视加水面波纹印刷（与图012 同构图，仅机位不同）。分镜合并：图001/012/014 同属盒装陈列，收敛为首尾两镜；图004/009 同属户外饮水场景，合并为一镜；图002/005 同属蓝底斜切特写版式，拆为卖点镜与信任镜两镜；图003/008 分别保留为选型镜与对照镜；图013 保留为剖视结构镜。品类判定依据：产品为无电机、无电加热、靠更换耗材工作的饮水容器配件，随水壶饮水机使用与陈列，故不判「家用电器」；也不属清洁剂或厨具，改判 家居日用/水具餐具，leaf 取「净水壶替换滤芯」，与提示标题中的饮水容器耗材用途一致。已剥离内容：原品牌字标与系列名、盒面注册标记与字样、圆形认证印章与检测标准名称、排名与销量类社会证明、更换周期与容量与件数等全部数值主张、被减除物质的具名清单、对照表中自家与竞品型号行与列主张、原平台店铺字样、方形扫码图、两位真人（含未成年模特）的面容与身份、以及全部英文原文案；产品一律以 {product} 占位，所有事实位改为空白参数行、空白表格单元、空白印章框与留空指示条。
